name: Ruou sim
summary: Wine of forest sim fruit. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam names it at Bãi Sao and in the national park. The night account calls it myrtle wine and lists it among the things to buy at the Dinh Cau night market. A strength was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Quoc. Bãi Sao, the park, and the Dinh Cau night market.
howToEat: Drink it at Bãi Sao or on the forest walk. The night account also says to buy a bottle at the Dinh Cau night market.
A strength and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Bãi Sao, the national park, and the Dinh Cau night market. A shop door is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ruou sim rung — forest sim wine on Phu Quoc
seoDescription: Rượu sim rừng is forest sim wine at Bãi Sao and in the park. The night account calls it myrtle wine. A price is Check on arrival.
